name: Living Shadow
summary: Ravenloft Dark Gift. Your shadow works a Mage Hand and lengthens your reach; a natural 1 lets it take you over for a moment.

benefits.name: Grasping Shadow
benefits.summary: You know Mage Hand; the hand is your shadow.
benefits.text: You learn Mage Hand and cast it with no components; the hand is your shadow. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is the casting ability (picked with the gift).

benefits.name: Lengthened Strike
benefits.summary: A melee attack roll in your Attack or Magic action can reach 10 feet farther (PB times per Long Rest).
benefits.text: When you make a melee attack roll as part of the Attack or Magic action on your turn, your shadow can carry it: +10 feet of reach for that attack. Uses: your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

drawback.name: Ominous Will
drawback.summary: On a natural 1: Wisdom save (DC 13 + PB) or Incapacitated until your next turn, which your shadow then runs (a d8: wander, lash out at a random creature, or fall Prone).
drawback.text: Right after a D20 Test shows a 1 on the d20, your shadow pushes back: make a Wisdom save (DC 13 + your Proficiency Bonus). Fail, and you are Incapacitated until your next turn starts; then roll a d8 for that turn. 1: no action or Bonus Action, and you spend all your movement walking one way (a d4 picks north, east, south or west). 2-6: no movement or Bonus Action; you take the Attack action for one melee attack on a random creature in reach, or no action if none is. 7-8: you fall Prone and your turn ends.
